description: A shared projection: what a view of one record shape returns. The record's key is the NSID of the shape it applies to, so a grant that pins {nsid, cid} names THIS record at that version -- the nsid picks the record, the cid pins which version of the projection was promised.

main.description: Readable by anyone who can read the authority's repo in the space: a projection is policy, and policy is public while the key that applies it is not.

fields.description: The fields a view returns, as RFC 6901 pointers. Everything outside them is dropped; `$type` is always kept by the reader.

condition.description: Only covers a record that satisfies it, the same closed comparison a grant can carry.
The datetime at `field` must be no older than `maxAgeSeconds` when the grant is checked.
